category_title: Low socially competent children who engage in disruptive alternative activities when bored
scenario_title: Peer criticism and emotional withdrawal during project presentation
minimal_context: The student is showing her family tree project in her notebook to her peers in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please show your family tree project in your notebook to the rest of the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I wrote down the names I wanted.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Some of the other children are saying that one of the names is wrong.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Says with a firm tone and expresses frustration) Kerttu, Kerttu is a girl's name!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's keep talking about your project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Is quiet for a while, then begins to express being hurt and puts her notebook away. The communication ends.)

context.social_setting: Showing her family tree project to peers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When criticized or evaluated by peers, reacting to their criticism/disbelief about a name
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Says with a firm tone and expresses frustration: 'Kerttu, Kerttu is a girl’s name!'. Is quiet for a while, and then begins to express being hurt and puts her notebook away. The communication ends.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Expresses frustration, expresses being hurt, feels treated unfairly

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Defending their own answer when criticised, expressing what they wanted or thought and expressing unfairness.
